methodology.title: Know what each observation can tell you.

items.title: Qualifying observations
items.description: Targets are published when the service's predefined conditions are met. A target identifies a price level and direction; it is not an instruction to enter, exit, or size a position.

items.title: Recorded outcomes
items.description: Reached means available market data recorded price meeting or crossing the target in its direction. Unreached means no qualifying reach was recorded within the session being reviewed. An unresolved target is still awaiting resolution.

items.title: Reading the statistics
items.description: Compare target outcomes alongside their timestamps, sample sizes, and reporting coverage. Partial periods and missing information are identified so your team can interpret the record in context.

methodology.boundary: A recorded target outcome is not a trading return. Execution, costs, position management, and your firm's own trades are outside this record.

faq.title: Questions from a professional desk.

items.question: What exactly am I subscribing to?
items.answer: Real-time intraday NQ targets and secure dashboard access to statistics around those targets: daily counts and outcomes, weekly reports, and historical and rolling analysis within your licensed history. You also receive a completed-session daily target report by email.

items.question: How do I receive real-time targets?
items.answer: Sign in to Today's Targets to follow real-time intraday NQ targets, including target prices, direction, source timestamps, and current status. The dashboard checks for new targets and status updates every 60 seconds. Targets appear when qualifying conditions are met.

items.question: What happens when there are no qualifying targets?
items.answer: A session may produce no targets. An absence of qualifying observations is part of the record, not a promise that a target will be produced every day.

items.question: How much history is included?
items.answer: Entity Core includes rolling 90-day history. Desk Intelligence includes rolling 365-day history. Firm-Wide Enterprise history is defined in the Order Form. The same core dashboard views are available across licenses.

items.question: Which delivery options are included?
items.answer: Every license includes the dashboard and daily target report emails for one verified recipient per licensed seat, with an individual opt-out: 1 for Entity Core, 5 for Desk Intelligence, and 15 for Firm-Wide Enterprise unless expanded by Order Form. Review weekly target reports in the dashboard. Desk Intelligence and Firm-Wide Enterprise separately include read-only daily, weekly, and historical target data through the API, plus up to 5 or 50 daily stats webhooks respectively. Email and webhooks do not deliver live target alerts.

items.question: Can I inspect the product before applying?
items.answer: Yes. Review the public excerpt without a form, then request the full October 12, 2026 report. Full-report delivery requires work-email confirmation and review. Submitting a request does not book a meeting, start a trial, or activate a subscription.

items.question: Does this monitor our trades or place orders?
items.answer: No. The record covers {brand.fullName}'s targets and their observed outcomes. It does not ingest your desk's trading results, route orders, or provide personalized recommendations.

items.question: What should our team evaluate?
items.answer: Inspect the report's definitions and context, the history your team needs, and the delivery and internal-use rights that fit your workflow. Assess observations across an appropriate sample; one session does not establish typical results.
